title: InfrastructureReservation
description: Activity in which a certain service, space, or object is reserved in advance for future use.

reservedFor.description: The Activity for which the Infrastructure is reserved. Lijst van Activity items.

periodOfProject.description: The amount of time for which the Reservation is valid. Lijst van PeriodOfProject items.

status.description: Current state, position, or situation of a person, place, object, system, or process at a particular time. Lijst van InfrastructureReservationStatus items.

buffer.description: Period that creates time or space for a process or action. In connection with room reservation, a "buffer" is used to prevent two events or meetings from being scheduled immediately after each other in the same room. It is a fixed time span that cannot be reserved after a room reservation. For example, if a room is booked between 10 am and 5 pm and it can only be booked once a day, the buffer is 8 am to 10 am and 5 pm to 6 pm (opening hours of the room). Lijst van PeriodOfProject items.

locationDescription.description: Detailed and systematic recording of the characteristics, condition, and specific details of a location or space. Lijst van LocationDescription items.
